Professional Career

Senior Data Scientist

GE HealthCare · Remote
2023 – Present

Developing innovative applications of deep learning and computer vision for clinical ultrasound imaging.

  • Train and evaluate deep learning computer vision models for the segmentation of lung ultrasound images.
  • Created a sophisticated post-processing pipeline for processing and interpreting segmentation model outputs.
  • Transferred and organized large sets of medical image data from clinical sites, partnering directly with physicians and sonographers to establish and review ground-truth annotations.
  • Served as the primary technical team member conducting verification and validation (V&V) testing for an FDA submission.

Data Scientist

Certilytics · Remote
2021 – 2023

Machine learning research and development for large-scale healthcare analytics and predictive modeling.

  • Explored and benchmarked novel methods for evaluating data representations in healthcare predictive models.
  • Engineered a procedural grouper pipeline for healthcare claims using interconnected machine learning models.
  • Designed, developed, and deployed deep learning models for healthcare analytics by adapting representation learning techniques from natural language processing (NLP).

Postdoctoral Research Fellow

Mayo Clinic CT Clinical Innovation Center · Rochester, MN
2020 – 2021

Advancing clinical outcomes in cardiac and renal imaging with photon-counting CT and deep learning.

  • Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team of physicists, radiologists, and engineers to develop novel clinical applications of photon-counting-detector computed tomography (PCD-CT) and deep learning.
  • Developed a convolutional neural network (CNN) image denoising and deconvolution pipeline to enhance high-spatial-resolution CT reconstructions.
  • Designed experiments, operated clinical and research CT scanners, performed image reconstructions, and presented findings at major medical imaging conferences (SPIE, RSNA, AAPM).

Graduate Research Assistant & Teaching Assistant

Wisconsin Plasma Physics Lab, University of Wisconsin–Madison · Madison, WI
2014 – 2020

Hardware development, computational forward modeling, and Bayesian integrated data analysis for fusion plasmas.

  • Commissioned and calibrated a novel PILATUS3-based Multi-Energy Soft X-Ray (ME-SXR) pinhole camera on the Madison Symmetric Torus (MST) in collaboration with the Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL).
  • Developed a physics-based Python forward model and Bayesian Integrated Data Analysis (IDA) framework to simultaneously infer electron temperature and impurity density profiles.
  • Authored Python acquisition, calibration, and database integration software; published 5 first-author and 5 co-author papers and presented at 7 scientific conferences.
  • Instructed students, developed assignments, and facilitated laboratory sections for introductory Physics I and II courses (2014–2015).
